scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
I think we're really
fortunate to be able to
live in such a beautiful
and peaceful city like this.
scripts.translation:
[智元]
我觉得我们真的很幸运，
能生活在这座美丽又宁静的城市里。

scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
It's just so nice to
have this pleasant weather,
these lush gardens and to
meet all of these kind people.
Lighthalzen is like Asgard
in Midgard, heaven on earth~
scripts.translation:
[智元]
天气这么宜人，
花园这么茂盛，
还能遇到这么多善良的人。
里希塔乐镇简直就是米德加尔特的人间天堂~

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
It gets harder for me
to move around as I get
older. That's understandable
for an elderly person, right?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
年纪大了，
行动越来越不便了。
这对老人来说很正常，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
Just the other day, these
hoodlums in black suits
were yelling at me to get out
of their way. But of course,
I didn't move quickly enough.
So what did they do to me?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
就在前几天，
几个穿黑西装的混混
冲我大喊让我让路。
但我当然没来得及挪开。
结果他们对我做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
They punched me.
Right in the womb!
I know that I'm not
pregnant, but that's
besides the point. Never hit
a lady, especially an old one!
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
他们打了我。
直接打在我的肚子上！
我知道我没怀孕，
但这不是重点。永远不要打女士，
尤其是老女士！

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
Sweety, isn't it
nice to be together
under this beautiful
sunlight? It's perfect
for our date. Ahhhh~
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
甜心，
在这美丽的阳光下
和你在一起真美好。
这对我们的约会来说
简直完美。啊~

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
I'm so happy to be
with you. I feel like
I'm just melting with
happiness. Oh, I love
you so much, Oyoung.
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
和你在一起我好开心。
我感觉自己都要
被幸福融化了。哦，
我太爱你了，五荣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
This couple is
really headed for
Cloud 9, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...
这对情侣
真是乐在其中啊，
不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
Girl, you look like
you're comin' down with
the love bug. But there's
only one prescription for
this ailment, ooooh yeah...
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
女孩，
你看起来像是
染上了相思病。
但这病只有一种解药，
哦，没错...

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
You need yo'self
your daily dose of
vitamin O-YOUNG.
And your lips look like
they got vitamin deficiency.
I better take care of that~
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
你需要每天补充
维生素五荣。
而且你的嘴唇看起来
像是缺乏维生素。
我得好好照顾一下~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sweet Sister!
I don't know what's
more mind boggling--
The fact that he used
that line or the fact that
it's actually working...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
甜蜜的姐姐！
我不知道哪个更让人难以置信——
是他用了那句台词，
还是那句台词竟然真的奏效了...

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
I think ''Lighthalzen'' is
supposed to mean ''crest of
light,'' though I hear that this
city was actually named after
somebody. Who knows for sure?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
我觉得“里希塔乐镇”
应该是“光辉之冠”的意思，
不过听说这座城市
其实是按某个人的名字命名的。
谁知道呢？

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
Still, it's a fitting
name for the wealthiest
and most luxurious city in
all the Schwarzwald Republic.
So how do you like this place?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
不过，这个名字
确实很适合修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
最富裕、最豪华的城市。
你觉得这里怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Sung]
When I grow up, I want
to become such a great
person that they'll make
a statue of me, just like
those statues over there.
scripts.translation:
[成]
等我长大了，
我想成为一个伟大的人，
就像那边的那些雕像一样，
人们也会为我立一座雕像。

scripts.text:
[Sung]
Then people would be like,
''Hey yo. That statue. That
guy must have been great!''
Just thinking about that
makes me feel so good!
scripts.translation:
[成]
那样人们就会说，
“嘿，看那个雕像。
那个人一定很厉害！”
光是想想就让我
感觉特别好！

scripts.text:
[Sung]
That's it. I'm gonna
grow up as soon as I can.
Ooh, and I better grow tall
and handsome so my statue
will be even more awesome.
Yeah. Yeah, good idea, Sung...
scripts.translation:
[成]
没错。我要尽快长大。
哦，我还要长得又高又帅，
这样我的雕像
就会更加威风。
对。对，好主意，成...

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
There are too many
loving couples in this city.
Cuddling and kissing and
hugging and necking. It's...
It's utterly distasteful.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
这座城市里
有太多的情侣了。
拥抱、亲吻、
搂抱、接吻。真是...
真是令人作呕。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I can't believe the
indecency I see everyday
near my own home. Don't
they know better than to be
so affectionate in places
where the public can see them?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
我无法相信
每天在我家附近
看到的这些不雅行为。
他们难道不知道
在公共场合
这么亲热是不对的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
Fortunately for the
world, I'm a bulwark
of morality. In fact, I have
no need for a woman. All
I need are my ship models,
teen novels and dominoes.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
幸运的是，
我是道德的捍卫者。
事实上，我不需要女人。
我只需要我的船模、
少年小说和多米诺骨牌。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I'm a completely well
adjusted individual, which
is why the authorities should
listen to me when I tell them
to arrest couples for indecency!
Hand holding. Have they no shame?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
我是一个完全
身心健全的人，
所以当局应该听我的，
逮捕那些在公共场合
举止不雅的情侣！
牵手。他们难道没有羞耻心吗？！

scripts.text:
[Janice]
Oh no, I think I got
lost again. The roads
here are so confusing!
I've lived here for such
a long time and I still
can't find my way around...
scripts.translation:
[珍妮丝]
哎呀，我又迷路了。
这里的道路太复杂了！
我住在这里这么久了，
还是找不到回家的路...

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
Walking side by side
with you like this reminds
me of the old days. Back
then, everyone was jealous
that I had such a beautiful
woman by my side. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
像这样和你并肩散步，
让我想起了过去的日子。
那时候，大家都嫉妒我，
因为我身边有这么美丽的女士。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
You're still the most
precious sight to these
old eyes, my dear. I'm
really lucky to be with you.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
亲爱的，你依然是我眼中
最珍贵的风景。能和你在一起，
我真的太幸运了。

scripts.text:
[Margie Keays]
Oh darling, the
weather is so nice
and pleasant today.
I'm really glad we
decided to go take
a walk together~
scripts.translation:
[玛吉·基斯]
亲爱的，今天的天气
真好，让人心情舒畅。
真高兴我们决定
一起出来散步~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
...

[Maivi]
Ah...
I just had the nicest
nap. This nice weather
never fails to relax me.
The air here is so clean,
not like that Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
啊...
我刚睡了一个好觉。
这美好的天气
总能让我放松下来。
这里的空气真清新，
不像艾音布罗克~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
This clean, pristine
environment is all thanks
to the Rekenber Corporation.
It's incredible what they can
do with technology now, isn't
it? Ahhh, it's so peaceful~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
这洁净、纯净的环境，
都要归功于雷肯贝尔公司。
现在的科技真是不可思议，
不是吗？啊，这里真宁静~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Excuse me, but are you
a tourist? Well, welcome
to Lighthalzen! This city
has everything we need,
but it can be a little too
quiet and uneventful here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
请问，您是游客吗？
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇！
这座城市拥有一切我们需要的东西，
但这里可能有点太安静、
太缺乏新鲜事了。

scripts.text: Have you lived in here long?
scripts.translation: 你在这里住很久了吗？

scripts.text: I agree.
scripts.translation: 我同意。

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过连环杀手吗？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, our family has
lived in this city for a
long time, starting with
my great grandfather. Let's
see, my family's been here
for about two hundred years.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是的，我的家族
在这座城市生活了很久，
从我的曾祖父那辈开始。
让我想想，我的家族
在这里已经生活了大约两百年了。

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You'd be surprised how
many people stay in their
hometowns. Even if you do
leave, though, you can always
come back. It wouldn't be your hometown if you couldn't, right?
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
你会惊讶地发现，
有多少人留在自己的家乡。
即使你离开了，
你随时都可以回来。
如果不能回来，
那它就不是你的家乡了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, the atmosphere
can get pretty listless
around here. But still,
there are plenty of nice
sights to enjoy here in
Lighthalzen, so look around~
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是的，这里的气氛
有时候会显得有点沉闷。
不过，里希塔乐镇
还是有很多美景值得欣赏的，
所以四处逛逛吧~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You mean the Serial
Axe Murderer? I thought
that was an old ghost story.
Hm. I think that lady inside
the Weapon Shop would
know more about that tale...
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
你是说连环斧头杀手？
我以为那只是个古老的幽灵故事。
嗯。我想武器店里的
那位女士会知道更多关于
那个故事的事情...

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
You know what I noticed?
The guards at the border
to the slum seem distracted
sometimes. I made use of one
of their less attentive moments
and basically jumped the fence!
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
你知道我注意到什么吗？
通往贫民窟边境的卫兵
有时候看起来心不在焉。
我利用了他们一个
不太注意的时刻，
基本上就是翻过了围栏！

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
But once I was in the 
slums, I was pretty bored.
There really isn't much to
do there. Which makes me
wonder... Why guard it?
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
但一旦我进了贫民窟，
我就觉得很无聊。
那里真的没什么可做的。
这让我很好奇...
为什么要守卫那里？

scripts.text:
[Joyce]
I can sense your
longing look within
the depths of my heart,
beating faster and faster
with a feverish passion~
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯]
我能感受到你眼中的渴望，
它在我内心深处跳动，
越来越快，带着
一种狂热的激情~

scripts.text:
[Dan Song]
Those eyes of yours...
So pure and so deep,
like glimmering pools
of light. So, so beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[丹·宋]
你那双眼睛...
如此纯净，如此深邃，
像闪烁的光池。
真美，真美...

scripts.text:
[Collins]
I really wish that my
son will be able to join
the Rekenber Corporation.
They certainly provide the
best jobs in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
我真希望我儿子能加入里希塔乐镇的雷肯贝尔公司。
他们那里的工作待遇绝对是全镇最好的。

scripts.text:
[Collins]
Although they're a large,
major corporation, it's
almost impossible to get
employed by them. How
do people get hired there
in the first place anyway?
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
虽然那是一家大型主要企业，但想被录用几乎是不可能的。
人们到底是怎么被他们雇用的呢？

scripts.text:
[Villagomez]
I just step out to get
a haircut and now I'm
lost. Boy oh boy, I hope
I don't keep my family
waiting. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[维拉戈梅斯]
我只是出去剪个头发，结果就迷路了。
天哪，希望别让我家人等太久。^333333*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
Have you ever seen the
people who work in that big
corporation over there? I think
their employees are all a bit
off kilter for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
你见过在那边那家大公司工作的人吗？
我觉得他们的员工都有点不正常，不知为什么。

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
I haven't been there
myself, but something
strange is happening with
all the people who work there.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
我自己没去过那里，但在那家公司工作的人身上似乎发生了一些奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
The youth in this city
have no appreciation for
their elders. I've worked
so hard to help build this
city for so many years and
this is the thanks I get?
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
这座城市的年轻人根本不尊重长辈。
我辛苦多年帮助建设这座城市，得到的却是这种回报？

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
Bah! If it weren't for
us, Lighthalzen wouldn't
be as prosperous as it is
today! Those kids don't
know that they owe their
lives of luxury to us...
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
哼！要不是我们，里希塔乐镇今天不会这么繁荣！
那些孩子根本不知道他们的富裕生活是我们给的...

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
Good looks. Intelligence.
Excellent manners. A strong,
manly chin and overpowering,
piercing eyes. Perfectly balanced passion and charisma. All the
good things that ladies want.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
英俊的外表。聪明的头脑。
优雅的举止。强壮而充满男子气概的下巴，以及深邃迷人的眼睛。
完美平衡的热情与魅力。女士们想要的一切优点。

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
But enough about me. Let's
discuss how sorry I should
feel for any other man living
in Lighthalzen. They don't hold
a candle to my studliness~
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
不过先不说我了。让我们聊聊我对里希塔乐镇其他男人的同情吧。
他们在我这英俊的外表面前简直不值一提~

scripts.text:
[Jade]
I've heard that there's a
strange kingdom out there
that's basically ruled by
magic and swords, where
adventurers are enlisted
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
我听说外面有一个奇怪的王国，基本上是由魔法和剑统治的，
那里的冒险者被招募起来为了更大的善。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
So are you from
Rune-Midgarts?
What do you think
of our city with its
advanced technology
and economy? Huh...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
那么你是来自卢恩·米德加兹吗？
你觉得我们这座拥有先进技术和经济的城市怎么样？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Someday, I'd like
to go visit the land
where you came from.
It sounds so fantastic
and romantic in a way...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
总有一天，我想去拜访你来自的那个地方。
听起来既神奇又浪漫...

scripts.text:
[Khramptd]
The land around here
is some pretty expensive
property. Yes, it's perfect
for building my awesome palace!
I don't have enough funds at the
moment, but the day will come~
scripts.translation:
[克拉姆普特]
这一带的土地相当昂贵。
没错，这非常适合建造我宏伟的宫殿！
我目前资金不足，但那一天会到来的~

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
Sure, I sell a lot
of flowers here, but
the lease that this city
makes me pay cuts into
my profits. It's almost not
worth renting this property.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
没错，我在这里卖很多花，
但这座城市让我支付的租金侵蚀了我的利润。
租这块地几乎不值得了。

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
I pay such a ridiculous
amount for the lease and the
laws here won't let me raise
the price of my flowers. Why
are the city officials so greedy?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我支付了如此荒谬的租金，
而这里的法律又不允许我提高花的价格。
为什么城市官员这么贪婪？

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
......
That lady, working
for that one company,
Kafra, Mafra or whatever.
She certainly is very charming.
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
......
那位女士，在那家公司工作，
卡普拉，马夫拉，或者随便什么。
她确实非常有魅力。

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
Now, if I were
thirty years younger...
Wait! I'm a rich and powerful
man. I could ask her out now.
Hm? What's that look for?
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
要是我年轻三十岁就好了...
等等！我是个富有且有权势的人。我现在就可以邀请她出去。
嗯？你那个眼神是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
Would you like to
make a donation
to help the hungry?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好，年轻人~
你愿意捐款帮助饥饿的人吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Now, you can donate 1 to
30,000 zeny that will be used
to support the poor and feed
starving children. If you wish
to cancel, please enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
现在，你可以捐赠1到30,000 Zeny，
这些钱将用于支持贫困者和喂养饥饿的儿童。
如果你想取消，请输入''0。'

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Please enter a value
from 1 to 30,000 in
order to make a donation
to the needy, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
请输入1到30,000之间的数值，
以便向贫困者进行捐款，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
How disappointing,
but I'm sure you have
your reasons. Well, when
you can afford to give to
the needy, you're welcome
to come back at any time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
真令人失望，
但我相信你有你的理由。
好吧，当你有能力帮助贫困者时，
欢迎随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Thank you so much
for your {0} zeny donation.
I promise that your money
will be put to good use in
benefiting the poor and needy.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
非常感谢你捐赠的{0} Zeny。
我保证，你的钱将被妥善使用，
以造福贫困者和需要帮助的人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Still, I'm just a little
disappointed. An adventurer
like you should be donating
as much as you possibly can...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
不过，我还是有点失望。
像你这样的冒险者，
应该尽可能多地捐款...

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
So far, I've received
a total of {0} zeny in
donations. I'm glad to see
that there are still kind and
generous people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
到目前为止，我总共收到了{0} Zeny的捐款。
很高兴看到世界上仍有善良和慷慨的人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
This should be enough
to send to the Poor Relief
Organization. Please accept
this small gift as a token of
my gratitude, adventurer. Bless
you, youngster and take care.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
这应该足够寄给贫困救济组织了。
请收下这份小礼物，以表达我的感激之情，冒险者。
祝福你，年轻人，保重。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
I understand. Still,
keep in mind that when
you give from your heart,
you will be rewarded tenfold.
Though I admit, the benefits
aren't always readily apparent.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
我理解。不过，请记住，
当你发自内心地给予时，
你将获得十倍的回报。
虽然我也承认，这种好处并不总是显而易见的。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
You seem to be fairly
well-off. Money is good
to have, but be careful not
to become obsessed with it.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好，年轻人~
你看起来相当富裕。
有钱是好事，但小心不要对它产生执念。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
When you have the chance,
please show your generosity
towards others who may be
much less fortunate than you.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
当你有机会时，
请向那些比你更不幸的人展示你的慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
Sure, manliness is quite
attractive, but I think women
appreciate a guy who could
sympathize and talk with them
a little more. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
当然，男子气概很有吸引力，
但我觉得女性更欣赏那些能体谅她们、
愿意和她们聊天的男人。你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
I might not be like Sefith,
but I guess I've got a cute
smile, a good personality and
I'm a dandy to boot. Hopefully,
my honesty and loyalty will
help me find someone good.
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
我可能不像塞菲斯那样，
但我想我有着可爱的笑容、良好的性格，
而且还是个花花公子。希望我的诚实和忠诚能帮我找到合适的人。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you are experiencing
any sort of inconvenience,
please do not hesitate and
let us know right away.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
如果您遇到任何不便，
请毫不犹豫地立即告知我们。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Please use the stairs
at the northern end to
go downstairs so that you
can go to the Front Desk.
Thank you and I hope that
you enjoy your stay here.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
请使用北端的楼梯下楼，
以便前往前台。
谢谢，希望您在这里住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Michael]
OoooOoh~
Soooo comfortable.
Don't want to wake up.
Don't want to get up.
Ever again. OoOoooh...
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·迈克尔]
噢噢噢~
太舒服了。
不想醒来。
不想起床。
永远都不想。噢噢噢...

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
This hotel is nice
and comfortable, but
to be quite frank, the
drinks here are horrible.
They're unfit for drinking
men such as myself.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
这家酒店不错，也很舒适，
但坦白说，这里的酒很难喝。
根本不适合像我这样的男人喝。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
If this is the best hotel,
I expect them to provide me
with the best alcohol. When
I stay at a hotel, that's what
I want. To spend the entire
day not being sober.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
如果这是最好的酒店，
我就期望他们能提供最好的酒。
我住酒店时，想要的就是这个。
整天都保持醉酒状态。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
It looks like that
today I'll be heading
out to the bar again...
I just wish there were
someplace quieter to drink.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
看来今天我又得去酒吧了...
我真希望能有个更安静的地方喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
This is the Couple Suite.
A single can also check
in here, but our hotel will
prioritize couples when
assigning this room.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
这是情侣套房。
单人也可以入住，
但酒店在分配此房间时会优先考虑情侣。

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
This chair looks
very nice, but it really
chills my bottom. Brr...!
It's a might uncomfortable!
scripts.translation:
[田上]
这把椅子看起来很不错，
但坐上去屁股好凉。好冷...！
有点不舒服！

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
You know what the
perfect chair would
be like? It would be
plush and have electronic
massage and heating controls...
scripts.translation:
[田上]
你知道完美的椅子是什么样的吗？
它应该是软绵绵的，并且带有电子按摩和加热控制功能...

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
Aaahhh Oooooh~
It's sooooo comfy~
The air's so fresh and
this couch is so plush...
Why can't home be like this?
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
啊~好舒服~
空气好清新，
沙发好柔软...
为什么家里不能这样呢？

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
I've been in those other
hotels and let me tell you,
this place is the best ever.
After a night's sleep over
here, I feel like a new man!
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
我住过其他酒店，
但让我告诉你，
这里绝对是最好的。
在这里睡一晚，
我感觉自己焕然一新！

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Oh sweet jiminy...
That Kafra Lady is so hot.
What a body. And those glasses.
I just gotta ask her out somehow.
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
天哪...
那位卡普拉的女士好迷人。
身材真好。还有那副眼镜。
我得想办法约她出去。

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Hm, but what should
I do? A love letter? Naw,
that's kind of outdated.
Argh, I can't think! Just
looking at her makes me feel
so happy! Praise be to Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
嗯，但我该怎么做呢？
写情书？不，
那太老套了。
啊，我想不出来！
光是看着她我就好开心！
感谢卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
''Hospitality with a smile
and total devotion to your
comfort.'' That's our motto
in the Royal Dragon Hotel.
Please inquire at the front
desk if you wish to check in.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
“微笑服务，
全心全意为您营造舒适体验。”
这是皇家龙酒店的座右铭。
如果您想办理入住，
请前往前台咨询。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Welcome to the
Royal Dragon Hotel Bar.
How about a nice night
cap before going to bed?
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
欢迎光临皇家龙酒店酒吧。
睡前来一杯
助眠饮品怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you're looking
for a friend, you
can almost always
make one in this bar.
Alcohol certainly is the
grease for social gears.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
如果你想找朋友，
在这个酒吧里
几乎总能找到。
酒精确实是
社交的润滑剂。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Oh yeah. I love-love-love
bars. If I don't come here
for the booze, then I'm here
for all these beautiful ladies.
scripts.translation:
[八]
没错。我超爱酒吧。
如果我不为了喝酒，
那就是为了这里
所有美丽的女士们。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Weird. It's the very first
time I've tried this place's
rum, but doesn't it taste like
pure sexiness to you? Huh...
Oh well, back to schmoozin'
with all the hot chicks~
scripts.translation:
[八]
奇怪。这是我
第一次尝试这里的朗姆酒，
难道它尝起来
像纯粹的性感吗？嗯...
算了，继续去
搭讪那些美女吧~

scripts.text:
[Duff]
Hey, you're from
Rune-Midgarts, right?
Please make yourself
at home while you're here
in Lighthalzen and have
yourself a good time.
scripts.translation:
[达夫]
嘿，你是从
卢恩·米德加兹来的吧？
在里希塔乐镇期间
请自便，
祝你玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I hate it when guys
just sidle up and sort
of just skip Steps One
and Two. And before you
get all weird, Step Three
is ''Ask for my phone number.''
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
我讨厌那些家伙
直接凑过来，
跳过第一步和第二步。
在你觉得奇怪之前，
第三步是“问我的电话号码”。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I would just really
appreciate it if one
nice boy would just
talk to me for real.
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
我真的希望
有个好男孩
能真心实意地
和我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
I don't believe it...
This unlucky streak
will never end, will it?
I lost all my Apples
playing Dice today.
Again. Oh man...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
我不相信...
这种倒霉运气
永远不会结束吗？
我今天玩骰子
输光了所有的苹果。
又是这样。天哪...

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
Okay. Okay.
If I just keep
playing, eventually
I'll win. I mean, that's
the way the odds work, right?
Even when they're against me...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
好吧。好吧。
只要我继续玩，
迟早会赢的。我是说，
概率就是这样运作的，对吧？
即使是对我不利的时候...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
I'm not big on drinking,
but the atmosphere in this
place is really nice. The
music they play is always
smooth and relaxing...
scripts.translation:
[特里]
我不太爱喝酒，
但这里的氛围
真的很不错。他们播放的
音乐总是流畅而放松...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
Yeah, this is a real cozy
joint. I recommend it to
all you tourists, actually.
Now why don't you kick
back and chill with me?
scripts.translation:
[特里]
是的，这里真的很舒适。
我其实推荐所有
游客来这里。
现在，何不放松一下，
和我一起享受时光？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
You see that guy?
That guy over there is
always looking at me.
I wonder... Does he want
to ask me out or something?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
你看到那个家伙了吗？
那边那个家伙
总是看着我。
我在想...他是想
约我出去吗？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, if he does,
shouldn't he have
more guts? Or are 
you boys much more
shy than I think you are?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
嗯，如果是的话，
他难道不该
更有胆量吗？还是说
你们男孩比我想象的
还要害羞？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, he is sort of
cute. Geez, this would
be so much easier if he
would just come up and
start talking to me...
scripts.translation:
[圣]
嗯，他确实有点可爱。
天哪，如果他
能直接过来
和我说话就好了...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Isn't the weather nice
today? All this sunlight
will dry these clothes
quickly and give them
a fresh, lovely scent.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
今天的天气真好啊？
这些阳光会很快
晒干这些衣服，
并赋予它们
清新宜人的香气。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, an adventurer from
Rune-Midgarts, are you?
How do you like our city?
If you have any questions,
feel free to ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，你是从卢恩·米德加兹来的冒险者吗？
你觉得我们的城市怎么样？
如果你有任何问题，
尽管问我吧。

scripts.text: Well, I have nothing to ask...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没什么要问的...

scripts.text: Any news or rumors?
scripts.translation: 有什么新闻或传闻吗？

scripts.text: I like laundry too.
scripts.translation: 我也喜欢洗衣服。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, really?
Well, if you've traveled
all over the world, maybe
you've found a place just
like Lighthalzen, so maybe
you're already comfortable?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，真的吗？
既然你游历过世界各地，
也许你找到过像里希塔乐镇一样的地方，
所以你已经很习惯这里了？

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Well, things have
been pretty peaceful
for the past few years.
The only rumor floating
around is about some
weird axe murderer...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
嗯，过去几年这里一直很太平。
唯一的传闻就是关于
某个奇怪的持斧杀人狂...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, that's wonderful!
I so love doing hand
laundry, though I'm not
quite sure why. Oh well~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，那太好了！
我真的很喜欢手洗衣服，
虽然我也说不清为什么。哎呀~

scripts.text:
[Berru]
Daddy...! Waaaaah~!
I wanna see my Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
爸爸...！哇啊啊~！
我想见爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Berru, I don't 
think Daddy's coming
home tonight. Come on,
we should go to bed.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
贝鲁，我觉得爸爸
今晚不会回来了。快去吧，
我们该睡觉了。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
No, I'm not gonna
sleep till Daddy gets
home! He said he'll
bring us candy tonight!
You go sleep first, Pilia!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
不，爸爸不回来
我就不睡觉！他说过
今晚要给我们带糖果的！
你先去睡吧，皮莉娅！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Where's our Daddy?
He said he found a
good job, but we haven't
heard from him since then...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
爸爸在哪里呢？
他说他找到了一份好工作，
但之后我们就没收到他的消息了...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
What's taking him
so long? I hope Daddy
comes back home soon.
Come on, Berru, don't cry.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
他怎么这么久还没回来？
希望爸爸能快点回家。
别哭了，贝鲁。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
^333333*Sob...*^000000
But I'm hungry
and I miss Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
^333333*抽泣...*^000000
但是我好饿，
而且我想爸爸了！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Uncle Togii from
next door hasn't
come back either...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
隔壁的托吉叔叔
也还没回来...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Hmm? Oh, I'm sorry,
but my little brother
just won't stop crying.
I'm sorry if we're loud...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
嗯？哦，对不起，
我弟弟就是哭个不停。
抱歉打扰到你们了...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Our daddy goes to work
somewhere far away. He
finally has a good job, but
sometimes we don't hear
from him for days. We get
really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
爸爸去很远的地方工作。
他终于找到了一份好工作，
但有时候好几天都联系不上他。
我们真的很担心他。

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
My brother Berru always
misses him a lot. I don't
know how to make him
stop crying! What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
我弟弟贝鲁总是很想念他。
我不知道怎么让他停止哭泣！
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Please...
My child is starving...
Would you give me
some money?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
求求你...
我的孩子快饿死了...
你能给我一些钱吗？

scripts.text: Give him some money.
scripts.translation: 给他一些钱

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I appreciate your
kindness, but it also
looks like you're in need
of zeny, too. Would you
like to join me?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
我很感激你的善意，
但看起来你也缺钱。
愿意和我一起吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you go,
take this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你，拿着吧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Thank you so much.
I have nothing to offer you
in exchange, but I can share
a story with you and impart
some of the wisdom I've
learned over the years.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
非常感谢。
我没有什么能回报你的，
但我可以给你讲个故事，
分享我这些年
学到的一些智慧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Everyone's been in
a situation where you
sometimes you feel that
you have to make a choice
between doing the right thing
and doing what you want, right?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
每个人可能都遇到过这种情况，
有时候你必须在
做正确的事
和做你想做的事之间
做出选择，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
You may feel trapped.
Well, let me tell you, when
it comes to a problem, all
the solutions available to
you aren't always obvious.
So just calm down and think.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你可能会感到被困住了。
让我告诉你，
面对问题时，
所有可用的解决方案
并不总是显而易见的。
所以冷静下来，好好想想。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What you can see and
understand might not match
with reality. Like the stars that are always there, but not visible
during the day, we'll always have hope, even if we can't see it.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你能看到和理解的
可能与现实不符。
就像星星一直都在，
只是白天看不见一样，
即使我们看不见，
希望也永远存在。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Hmm...?
You seem surprised~
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
嗯...？
你看起来很惊讶~

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I sort of believe in fate and
sort of don't. Let me explain
it this way. I take life day by
day, with each day covering its
own spectrum with miracle on one end and tragedy on the other.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
我有点相信命运，
又有点不相信。
让我这样解释。
我一天一天地生活，
每一天都涵盖了自己的光谱，
一端是奇迹，另一端是悲剧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
So each day has the capacity
for experiences that can be
good, bad or both. I believe
each person can take an 
active role in shaping their
destiny, day by day.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
所以每一天都有
经历好事、坏事
或两者的可能性。
我相信每个人
都可以主动塑造自己的命运，
一天一天地。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Now, there may be certain
things that you can't control,
but even a pessimist might
be able to agree that this
is a world that not only has
tragedy, but miracles as well.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
当然，有些东西
是你无法控制的，
但即使是悲观主义者
可能也会同意，
这个世界不仅有悲剧，
也有奇迹。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Stand up when you're down
and live your life with passion. The capacity for miracles will
always be there and know that
you can be someone else's
miracle. Isn't that wonderful?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
跌倒时站起来，
充满激情地生活。
奇迹的可能性
永远都在，
要知道你可以成为
别人的奇迹。
这不是很棒吗？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't believe me?
Well, you'll see for
yourself, youngster.
There's much good in you.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不相信我？
好吧，你自己会看到的，
年轻人。
你身上有很多美好。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Anger. People deal with
it in different ways. Some
suppress it. Some relish it.
Some fear being angry. Now,
to be simple, let's say there
are two kinds of anger.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
愤怒。人们处理它的方式
各不相同。
有些人压抑它。
有些人享受它。
有些人害怕愤怒。
简单来说，
让我们说有两种愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The first is the kind that
isn't so productive. More of
a frustration that you can let
go. Someone cut you off on the
freeway or a friend innocently forgot your birthday? No biggie.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第一种是
不太有建设性的。
更多是一种
你可以放下的挫败感。
有人在高速公路上
插队，或者朋友
无辜地忘记了你的生日？
没什么大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't let this kind of
anger get to you or you'll
look like a loser. Think of
the big picture and if you're
still upset, vent appropriately. Be honest without hurting anyone.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不要让这种愤怒
影响你，否则你会
看起来像个输家。
从大局考虑，
如果你仍然生气，
适当发泄。诚实而不伤害任何人。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger
is righteous anger. You've
been wronged and need 
some form of retribution. 
Just don't misdirect your anger
and respond appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种愤怒
是正义的愤怒。
你被冤枉了，
需要某种形式的报复。
只是不要误发你的愤怒，
并做出适当的回应。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger is
righteous anger. You've been
wronged and need some form
of retribution. Remember to
make appropriate confrontations
and don't misdirect your rage.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种愤怒
是正义的愤怒。
你被冤枉了，
需要某种形式的报复。
记住要
进行适当的对抗，
不要误发你的怒火。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Getting into a fight with
righteous anger, say to protect
someone dear to you, will make
you a hero. Fighting with anger
born of frustration will make you a bully. Know the difference.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
带着正义的愤怒去战斗，比如为了保护你在乎的人，你会成为英雄。而带着挫败感引发的愤怒去战斗，只会让你变成恶霸。要分清这两者的区别。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What's wrong?
It might be a lot
to take in, I know.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
怎么了？
我知道，
一下子接受这么多
可能有点难。

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Someday...
Someday I just gotta
become a train conductor
and just get outta here!
I really hate this place!
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
总有一天...
总有一天我一定要
当上列车长，
然后离开这里！
我真的很讨厌这个地方！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]]
Wh-whoa...!
Did you just hear
me talk to myself?
Crud! Don't be so nosy!
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]]
哇...！
你刚才听到
我自言自语了吗？
该死！别这么爱管闲事！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Hey. What are
you doing just
looking at me?
I don't know you
from Adam, so get lost~
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
嘿。你一直
盯着我看干嘛？
我根本不认识你，
所以请走开~

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
Am I just getting
paranoid? I really
think that some of
the people I know
are disappearing
for no good reason!
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
我是不是
有点多疑了？
我真的觉得，
我认识的一些人
无缘无故地
消失了！

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
I mean, all of my close
friends are all alright,
but I'm starting not to see
certain acquaintances and
familiar faces. Maybe I'm
just thinking too much...
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
我是说，
我所有的密友
都还好，
但我开始见不到
某些熟人和
熟悉的面孔了。
也许我只是
想太多了...

scripts.text:
[Shayna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Oh, you poor
darling girl...

[Cenku Dekdam]
Man, if you were
gonna take this whole
city and then sell it, what
do you think Lighthalzen's
price tag would be, eh?
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
伙计，如果你打算
买下整个城市
然后再卖掉，
你觉得里希塔乐镇
的标价会是多少呢？

scripts.text:
[Cenku Dekdam]
I mean, this city
is basically just made
of money. Money is what
makes this city such a nice
and pleasant place to live.
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
我是说，
这座城市基本上
就是由金钱构成的。
正是金钱
让这座城市
成为如此美好
宜人的居住地。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
Greetings, adventurer.
I'm Angela, a social
worker for the Poor
Relief Organization.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
你好，冒险者。
我是安吉拉，
贫困救济组织的
社会工作者。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've noticed that the
people living here have
extremely bad health and
it's not just because of
their circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我注意到，
住在这里的人
健康状况极差，
而这不仅仅是
因为他们的处境。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've filed a report
to my superiors, but
they haven't sent me
a response yet for some
reason. I'm starting to get
a little worried about this...
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我已经向
上级提交了报告，
但不知为何，
他们还没有
给我回复。
我开始有点
担心了...

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Must work...
Must focus...
Resist sleepiness...
Why do I keep coming
here? Ugh, h-horrible.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
必须工作...
必须集中精神...
抵抗困意...
我为什么总是
来这里？唉，真糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Hey youngster. You wanted
adventuring advice? Okay.
Um. Hm. Always. Brush.
Your teeth. Brush them
everyday. Oh, and don't
forget to floss, either.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
嘿，年轻人。
你想要冒险建议？
好吧。
嗯。嗯。总是。
刷牙。
每天刷牙。
哦，还有，
别忘了用牙线。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Now it's time for me
to head back to work.
I'll see you later, kid.
Sorry my advice was so
lame-- I couldn't think of
anything else to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
现在，我该
回去工作了。
再见，小孩。
抱歉我的建议
这么无聊——
我想不出
其他可以告诉你的了。

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
So, the novel I ordered from
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
just recently arrived. It's real good, by the guy who wrote
''Roda Frog Adventure''
years ago. Remember?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
所以，我从
卢恩·米德加兹王国
订购的那本小说
最近刚到。它真的很好，
作者是几年前
写了《罗达蛙冒险》
的那个人。还记得吗？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Anyway, this new book,
''Where the Red Plant Grows''
is up for the Yggdrasilberry
Award. I... I don't know why
I was compelled to share that
with you. Seriously, I don't...
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
总之，这本新书
《红草生长的地方》
正在角逐
世界树浆果奖。
我...我不知道为什么
我会被驱使着
把这些告诉你。
说真的，我不...

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
...

[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Ellette]
...Oh! Everyone!
I just completed
another one! Hooray!
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
...哦！大家！
我又完成了一个！太棒了！

scripts.text:
[All other Employees]
Wh-what?!
No way, not again!
scripts.translation:
[其他所有员工]
什-什么？！
不会吧，又来了！

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
Are you even human?
You must have some
secret for that much
productivity. It's weird...
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
你到底是人吗？
你一定有什么秘诀
才能达到这么高的效率。
真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
Oh, come on.
Maybe I'm a little
good at this, but there's
no way I can beat Cenku.
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
哎呀。
也许我在这方面有点天赋，
但我绝对不可能比得上森库。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Just out of, oh I dunno,
curiosity, which word do
you like better? ''Uber-Cool''
or ''Reality?'' Pick one~
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
纯粹出于，呃，我不知道，
好奇心，你更喜欢哪个词？
“超酷”还是“现实”？选一个~

scripts.text: Uber-Cool
scripts.translation: 超酷

scripts.text: Reality
scripts.translation: 现实

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Oh yeah? Me too!
Yeah, we got the same
outlook on life. If you don't
mind, I'd like to shake
your hand, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
哦是吗？我也是！
看来我们对生活的看法
很一致。如果不介意的话，
我想和你握个手，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Reality, eh?
Well, I agree that
being realistic has its
perks, I'm more of a dreamer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
现实，是吗？
嗯，我承认务实
有其好处，但我更
喜欢做梦。

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
So... Very broke.
Why did I spend so much
money on wine, women and
song? I regret it all, all the
pleasure I've had this month.
Yes, it was too much pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
所以...非常穷。
我为什么要在酒、女人
和歌唱上花那么多钱？
我后悔了，后悔这个月
所有的快乐。
是的，快乐太多了。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
That's what happens
when you're irresponsible
with your money. You really
should read this ''Anybody
Can Be Rich'' book.
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
这就是你对金钱
不负责任的下场。你真的
应该读读这本《人人都能
变富》的书。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
At long last, I've finally
bought my own home. You
should invest your money for
your future too! Read this,
''Anybody Can Be Rich!''
It's such a great book!
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
终于，我买下了
自己的房子。你也应该
为未来投资你的钱！
读读这本《人人都能
变富！》
这是一本很棒的书！

scripts.text:
[Kejulle Rekenber]
Hm? Sure, my last name
is Rekenber and that's the
same name as our chairman,
but that's just a coincidence.
I'm merely a normal employee.
Yeah, no special treatment...
scripts.translation:
[凯朱勒·雷肯贝尔]
嗯？当然，我姓雷肯贝尔，
这和我们会长的姓氏
相同，但这只是巧合。
我只是一个普通员工。
是的，没有特殊待遇...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis man here
is motionless,
and for all intents
and purposes, is
soundly asleep.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这位男士
一动不动，
从各方面来看，
他都在熟睡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
What am I doing here?
Waiting for my dream
woman to fall into my lap,
what else does it look like?
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
我在这里做什么？
等着我的梦中情人
落入我的怀抱，
还能是什么？

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
Tall, blond, creamy
complexion and smooth
skin. That's right. Come
right to Joshua, babes.
I got my pheromone spray
on and I'm ready to cruise~
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
高挑，金发，
白皙的皮肤和光滑的
肌肤。没错。
快来找约书亚吧，宝贝。
我喷了费洛蒙喷雾，
准备去猎艳了~

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
You know the men in
black suits? Boy, did
I get a scare! They actually
tracked me down to ask me
all these weird questions!
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
你知道那些穿黑西装
的男人吗？天哪，
我吓坏了！他们竟然
追踪到我，问了我
很多奇怪的问题！

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
They kept wanting to
know if I had ever met
anyone from the Rekenber
Corporation, if I've ever been
Uptown, that sort of thing. They
really scared the crap out of me.
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
他们一直追问我是否见过雷肯贝尔公司的人，是否去过上城区之类的问题。他们真的把我吓坏了。

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
Man, living in the
slums is such a drag.
Not only is life rough,
but all sorts of people
think they can push you
around. I hate Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
天哪，住在贫民区真是够受的。
生活不仅艰难，
还有各种各样的人
想把你踩在脚下。
我讨厌里希塔乐镇...

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Whiskey!
I need me some
hard liquor now!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
威士忌！
我现在就要
烈酒！

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Wha--? I didn't
order this stinkin'
rum! I want a man's
drink! Gimme whiskey!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
什...？我没点
这该死的朗姆酒！
我要喝男人的酒！
给我威士忌！

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey man, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，伙计，我知道
这家店是个破酒馆，
简直快要变成贫民窟了，
但我们引以为傲的是，
这里有全米德加尔特
最好的朗姆酒。千真万确~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey lady, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，女士，我知道
这家店是个破酒馆，
简直快要变成贫民窟了，
但我们引以为傲的是，
这里有全米德加尔特
最好的朗姆酒。千真万确~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Just a sip of this
beautiful drink and
you're on top of the
world! But it's best
for helpin' yah relax
and forget your worries.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
只要抿一口
这美妙的饮品，
你就仿佛置身世界之巅！
不过它最适合
帮你放松身心，
忘却烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
I don't take to bein'
a poet, but I do know
this. Our rum has the
sweet sweet flavor of
loneliness. You really
oughta try it when you can.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
我不太擅长
写诗，但我深知
这一点。我们的朗姆酒
有着孤独
甜美的滋味。
你有空的时候
一定要尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey! Hey you...!
D'you wanna, you
wanna hear me tell
you a joke?! It goes...
Um, it goes like this...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿！嘿，你...！
你想不想，
想不想听我
讲个笑话？！是这样的...
呃，是这样的...

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey riddle middle,
the cat and th--
No! No, damn it!
That's a song!
No, wait, that's
not a song either...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿，谜语中间，
猫和那...
不！不，该死！
那是一首歌！
不，等等，那
也不是歌...

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
*Hiccup* I loooove
this rum! I caught a cold
once and one glass made
it go away! 'Course, I slept
for a week too, but that don't
matter! Pshaw! Science...
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
*打嗝* 我超爱
这朗姆酒！我有一次
感冒了，喝了一杯
就好了！当然，我
也睡了一周，但那不算
什么！哼！科学...

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
Oh, the flavor is just
so clean, but it's also
got a bit of a kick. I don't
know how to describe it.
Its the taste of happiness?
I'm too drunk to even tell!
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
哦，这味道
真清爽，但又
带点劲道。我不知
道该怎么形容。
是幸福的味道吗？
我喝得太醉，
都说不清了！

scripts.text:
[Assam]
This place is nice
and usually pretty quiet.
I like to come here after
work, have a drink and just
chat with the bartender.
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这里环境不错，
通常也很安静。
我喜欢下班后
来这里，喝点酒，
和调酒师聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Assam]
The rum here is incredibly
good too. It might even be
the best in the world. I dunno
why, but for some reason, its
taste reminds me of teamwork~
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这里的朗姆酒
也非常好喝。
它甚至可能是
世界上最好的。我不知道
为什么，但不知怎的，
它的味道让我
想起了团队合作~

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
Oh, I'm only here
working as a waitress
to help out my father.
This job is so tiring, but
it's nice to see people so
relaxed and having a good time.
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
哦，我只是
在这里当服务员
帮爸爸的忙。
这工作很累，但
看到大家
如此放松、玩得开心，
感觉真好。

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
When I get some time
off, I'm going to explore
Lighthalzen and see all that
there is to see. But for now,
it doesn't look like we've got
any real shortage of drunks...
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
等我休息的时候，
我要去探索
里希塔乐镇，看看
那里有什么。但现在，
看来我们这里
不缺醉鬼...

scripts.text:
[Enku]
*Sob* I just got
dumped! Yeah, I thought
we were gonna get married,
but obviously I was wrong!
Damn it Sheryline! I loved you!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
*抽泣* 我刚被
甩了！是的，我以为
我们要结婚了，
但显然我错了！
该死的雪琳！我爱你！

scripts.text:
[Enku]
I usually don't care for
drinking, especially stuff
like gin or rum, but today,
this stuff tastes just like
my misery. This is all the
comfort I need, you hear?!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
我通常
不喜欢喝酒，尤其是
金酒或朗姆酒，但今天，
这酒尝起来
就像我的痛苦。
这就是我
需要的所有安慰，你听到了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Linus]
After ten years
of marriage. My
wife divorced me...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
结婚十年
后。我
的妻子离婚了...

scripts.text:
[Linus]
So I guess there's no
place for me but here for
now. I don't know what it is,
but the rum is really good
today. Like, it's the flavor
of relaxing, joyous relief~
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
所以我想，
目前我只能
留在这里了。我不知道
为什么，但今天的
朗姆酒真的很好喝。
就像，它是
放松、快乐
解脱的味道~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
You know, everyone
is different, but I think
humans are similar enough
that we can all meaningfully
connect on some level, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
你知道吗，虽然每个人都不一样，但我认为人类在本质上足够相似，我们总能在某个层面上产生共鸣，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Sure, a rich person might
have different problems than
a poor person, but the point
is, they've both got problems!
Pain, pleasure, sadness, joy.
Those link us all together.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
没错，富人和穷人的烦恼可能不同，但重点是，他们都有烦恼！痛苦、快乐、悲伤、喜悦，这些情感将我们联系在一起。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
So try not to be picky
about who's your pal and
who's not. We all need
somebody to be with, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
所以，别太挑剔谁是朋友，谁不是。我们都需要有人陪伴，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dique]
One of the things I look
forward to during my day
is the drink I enjoy right
after work. It's the most
relaxing thing in the world.
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
我每天最期待的事情之一，就是下班后喝的那杯饮料。那是世界上最让人放松的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Dique]
Of course, there's
more to life than just
hanging out in pubs and
bars. The thing is, in my
case, pubs and bars are
all I happen to need~
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
当然，生活不仅仅是泡在酒吧里。不过对我来说，酒吧就是我需要的一切~

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
Do you know who I am?!
Just look at this peg leg.
I was in the Comodo War,
Ski Troop division! I lost my
leg to earn your freedom!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
你知道我是谁吗？！看看这条假腿。我参加过克魔岛战争，是滑雪部队的！我为了你们的自由失去了这条腿！

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
H-hey! What's that
look for? What, you
don't believe me?!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
嘿！你那个眼神是什么意思？难道你不相信我吗？！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This is a
restricted area.
Please keep clear
if you do not have
special authorization.
Thank you for your cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这里是限制区域。
如果没有特别许可，请保持距离。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh phooey.
The same customers
are always coming in,
day after day. Can it
get any less exciting?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
唉。
总是同样的顾客，日复一日地光顾。还能更无聊一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh...!
W-welcome~
C-can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
哦...！
欢...欢迎~
需...需要我为您做些什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Geonuii]
Greetings. This path
leads to the Library and
the Laboratory. Please be
aware that these places
are restricted from access
by the general public.
scripts.translation:
[格奴伊]
您好。这条路通往图书馆和实验室。请注意，这些地方禁止普通公众进入。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie]
Oh no...
Where did I put it?
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
糟糕...
我把它放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
^3355FF(Whoa, it's a member
of the staff!)^000000 Good day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
^3355FF（哇，是职员！）^000000 您好！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This is a restricted
area! Please show
some ID immediately!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
这里是限制区域！请立即出示证件！

scripts.text: ID?
scripts.translation: 证件？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I don't know how you
adventurers do things in
Rune-Midgarts, but over here
we have laws about trespassing!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
我不知道你们卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者是怎么做事的，但我们这里有关于非法入侵的法律！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Unless you have special
authorization, nobody is
allowed into the Underground
Laboratory for security reasons.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
除非持有特别许可，出于安全原因，任何人都不允许进入地下实验室。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Keep your eyes open.
I've heard rumors that some
adventurers from Rune-Midgarts
are trying to sneak into here!
I know the security here is
pretty much fail sure, but...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
要睁大眼睛。我听说有些来自卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者正试图潜入这里！我知道这里的安保几乎万无一失，但是...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This area is restricted
to the public! Who are you
and how did you get in here?!
Hey, I need backup right away!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
此区域禁止公众进入！你是谁？你是怎么进来的？！嘿，我需要支援，马上！

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
No wonder these things
break all the time! These
machines have been totally
abused! Ugh, there's no
appreciation for all of this
convenient technology...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
难怪这些东西老是坏！这些机器被彻底糟蹋了！唉，真没人珍惜这些便利的科技...

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Yeah, all of this lab
equipment is really sensitive,
not to mention expensive. If
you ever handle this stuff, you
need to be extra cautious.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
没错，这些实验室设备都非常精密，而且价格昂贵。如果你要操作这些设备，必须格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Hey, you don't work--
G-guards! Hurry! There's
somebody over here!
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
嘿，你不在这里工作——
卫...卫兵！快过来！这里有人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace the other test
tube over here and then
clean the first test tube?
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好的。先从机器里取出一支试管，
把另一支试管换过来，
然后清洗第一支试管？

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Or do I clean the test tube,
put it into the machine and
then replace the other one?
I'm so confused with this
procedure! If only I didn't
lose the instructions...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
或者是先清洗试管，
放进机器，
然后再换另一支？
我被这个流程搞糊涂了！
要是我没弄丢说明书就好了...

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace th--hey. You're
not Ralphie. Wait. Guaaards!
Help me, there's some weirdo!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好的。先从机器里取出一支试管，
换...嘿。你不是拉尔菲。
等等。卫...卫兵！
帮帮我，这里有个怪人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Whoa whoa~!
Please! Don't
touch anything!
I'm dealing with highly
volatile chemicals here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
哇哇~！
请！别碰任何东西！
我正在处理高挥发性化学品！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Guards! Hurry,
there's someone
here, and I think
it's one of those crazy
stalkers! Why, why me?!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
卫兵！快过来，
这里有人，
我觉得是那些疯狂的神行太保！
为什么，为什么是我？！

scripts.text: Nice day, huh?
scripts.translation: 天气不错，是吧？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
...!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
...！

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Do you wish to
go underground?
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
您想要去地下吗？

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
May I help you?
If you would like to
enter, you must first
have a Laboratory Permit.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
请问有什么可以帮您？
如果您想进入，
必须首先持有研究所进出卡片。
感谢您的配合。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
谢谢，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席尔姆卫兵]
谢谢，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Arthur]
The chairs here are
so not ergonomic. And
they're uncomfortable too!
But it's sooo cool inside this
bank and I just wanted to get
get away from all this heat...
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟]
这里的椅子一点都不符合人体工学。而且坐起来也不舒服！
但是这家银行里面好凉快啊，我只是想逃离外面的炎热...

scripts.text:
[Helen]
You know, maybe when
I grow up, I'll be a bank
clerk. That sounds like a
really nice job, don't you
think? It's laid back and posh...
scripts.translation:
[海伦]
你知道吗，也许等我长大了，我会成为一名银行职员。听起来是一份很棒的工作，你觉得呢？工作轻松又体面...

scripts.text:
[Tadem]
I do so enjoy the
architectural structure
of this bank. It's quite
artistic with both classical
and modern elements. Would
you not agree? Fascinating...
scripts.translation:
[塔德姆]
我非常欣赏这家银行的建筑结构。它兼具古典与现代元素，颇具艺术感。您不觉得吗？真是迷人...

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
Oh, it's so comfortable
in here~ Though, why are
we inside the bank when
the bank services aren't even
working? Yes, we're standing,
but we're doing it in comfort.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
哦，这里真舒服~ 不过，为什么银行服务没开放，我们却站在银行里面呢？是的，我们在站着，但我们站得很舒服。

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
In fact, it's so
comfortable here,
I think I'll refuse to leave.
Though, I'm willing to change
my mind if you can find a place
that's even more comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
事实上，这里太舒服了，
我想我会拒绝离开。
不过，如果你能找到一个更舒服的地方，
我愿意改变主意。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Due to some critical system
errors, all of the bank services
have been temporarily stopped.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
由于系统出现严重错误，
所有银行服务已暂时停止。
我们对造成的不便深表歉意，并感谢您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Togii]
Oooh yeah...
Goes down smooth.
Morocc whiskey's the best!
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Whoa, this stuff
really works fast! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[托吉]
哦哦，好喝...
入喉很顺滑。
莫洛克的威士忌最棒了！
^333333*打嗝*^000000 哇，这酒劲上得真快！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Healthy Looking Guy]
Grrrrrr! Leave me alone!
How many times do I have
to keep telling you? I've never
hoarded item upgrade materials!
I swear that I'm innocent!
scripts.translation:
[看起来很健康的家伙]
嘎啊啊啊！别缠着我了！
我到底要告诉你多少次？
我从来没有囤积装备强化材料！
我发誓我是清白的！

scripts.text:
[Hinkley]
Meh heh heh...
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Believe
it or notsh, I'm...
walkin on a... Air...
Nevah thought I could
b-be sho freee-eeee-eee~
scripts.translation:
[欣克利]
嘿嘿嘿...
^333333*打嗝*^000000 信不信由你，我...
正在空中... 漫步...
从没想过我能这...这么自...由~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis guy
is completely
hammered out
of his mind!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这家伙
完全喝得
烂醉如泥了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
Let me go!
Let me GO!!
LET ME GO!!!
I didn't do nuthin'
wrong! I'm innocent!
^333333*Hic-Hic-Hiccup...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[米莱特]
放开我！
放开我啊！！
放开我！！！
我没做错任何事！我是清白的！
^333333*嗝-嗝-嗝...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
What's wrong with
drinking and singing
in the street, huh?
Is it a crime to have
a beautiful tenor voice?!
Get me outta this joint!
scripts.translation:
[米莱特]
在街上喝酒唱歌有什么不对吗？
拥有优美的男高音嗓音也是犯罪吗？！
快把我从这鬼地方放出去！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
告诉我...！
告诉我...！！
承认是你干的！！

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
Damn it!
I keep telling
you I'm not guilty!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
该死！
我一直都说
我没有罪！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Suspect]
You're wasting your
time. Just let me go.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
你在浪费时间。
就放我走吧。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
So...
How's your mother?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
那么...
你母亲怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
That's none of
your business!
She's fine, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
这不关你的事！
她应该没事吧。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
When was the last
time you've seen her?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你最后一次见到她是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
I just told you,
that's none of
your business...!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
我刚说过，
这不关你的事...！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
You know, mothers
throughout the animal
kingdom instinctively
care for their young.
Humans are no exception.
Yours must be worried to death.
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你知道吗，动物界的母亲
都会本能地照顾幼崽。
人类也不例外。
你母亲一定担心得要死。

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
...
Man...
You're starting
to weird me out.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
...
天哪...
你开始让我
感到毛骨悚然了。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Funny thing about humans,
though. It seems to be their
nature to lie, even when they
know they'll be caught. But
like all animals, they
instinctively fear pain...
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不过，人类有个有趣的特点。
似乎撒谎是他们的天性，
即使知道会被揭穿。但
就像所有动物一样，
他们本能地恐惧痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
N-no, no...
You gotta be...
You're bluffing.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
不...不...
你肯定是在...
你在虚张声势。
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
NO.
You're bluffing.
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不。
你在虚张声势。
告诉我...！
告诉我...！！
承认是你干的！！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
This Banquet Hall is used
to hold events such as dinner
parties with partners, clients
and other associates, and press
conferences. Of course, there's
nothing going on right now.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
这个宴会厅用于举办
晚宴、招待合作伙伴、客户
及其他相关人士，以及新闻发布会。
当然，现在没有任何活动在进行。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
Sometimes peace and quiet
is a welcome change of pace,
but right now I'm feeling quite
bored. I think I would rather
be busy than twiddling my
thumbs, to tell the truth.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
虽然偶尔的宁静与祥和令人向往，
但说实话，我现在觉得挺无聊的。
与其坐在这里无所事事，
我宁愿忙碌一点。

scripts.text:
[Luccet]
Shhhh! Hey, my brother's
''it,'' so I gotta find a place
to hide! Wait, would you just
stand really still? I could
just hide behind you! No?
Nuts! Olly olly oxen free!
scripts.translation:
[卢塞特]
嘘！嘿，现在轮到我了，
我得找个地方躲起来！
等等，你能站得纹丝不动吗？
我可以直接躲在你身后！
不行吗？
真是的！捉迷藏开始啦！

scripts.text:
[Hanccet]
Man... I hate being ''it!''
I'm horrible at this game!
Alright, okay, if I were my
sister Luccet, where would
I think I would not look for
me? Of course...! The sewers!
scripts.translation:
[汉塞特]
天哪...我讨厌当“找人”的那个！
我玩这个游戏真的很糟糕！
好吧，好吧，如果我是我的妹妹卢塞特，
我会觉得哪里不会有人找我呢？
当然是...！下水道！

scripts.text:
[Annette]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Banquet Hall
is also used to hold weddings.
That must be so wonderful~
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
我听说雷肯贝尔宴会厅
也用来举办婚礼。
那一定非常美好~

scripts.text:
[Annette]
Even if it is more expensive,
I'd want to have my wedding
here. Marriage is only once
in a lifetime, ideally, so I'd
want to make mine the most
memorable experience.
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
即使费用更高，
我也希望在这里举办我的婚礼。
婚姻是一生一次的大事，
我希望我的婚礼能成为最难忘的回忆。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Shhhhhhzzzz*
*Shhhhhhzzzz*^000000

[Mereth]
Shhhhh....
Aaaaaaaahhh...
scripts.translation:
[梅雷斯]
嘘...
啊哈...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe employee turned his
head and peered into your
eyes through the black mask
on his face. Mereth stared
wordlessly for a moment and
then began to dance a lively,
creepily jovial jig.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那名职员转过头，
透过脸上的黑色面具凝视着你的眼睛。
梅雷斯沉默了片刻，
然后开始跳起一种活泼而诡异地欢快的舞蹈。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is simply a pile
of files, a smattering of
books and a family portrait.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只是一堆文件，
几本散乱的书，
以及一幅某个家族的肖像画。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk is very
neat and well organized
in comparison to the other
desks you've seen in your
time. You take a moment to
fully marvel at its tidiness.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF与你之前看到的其他办公桌相比，
这张桌子非常整洁有序。
你花了一点时间，
尽情欣赏它的整洁。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk has a bookshelf
that is crammed with all sorts
of books. Out of curiosity, you
decide to pick one out.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这张桌子上有一个书架，
里面塞满了各种各样的书。
出于好奇，
你决定拿出一本看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, the book you
happen to touch contains
an amazing amount of dark
power, causing you to drop it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF然而，你碰到的那本书
蕴含着惊人的黑暗力量，
吓得你把它扔掉了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Noama]
Hee hee~!
You wanna hear
something funny?
I heard there's a bar in
Prontera where this guy
sneaks singles into Jawa--
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
嘿嘿~！
你想听个笑话吗？
我听说普隆德拉有一家酒吧，
有个家伙偷偷把单身汉带进爪哇--

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
诺阿玛...！
这些机器又出故障了！
马上过来！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
什么？！
别烦我了，
我什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Crap. Crap! Crap
crap crap crap crap!
These desk machines aren't
supposed to work like this!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
糟了。糟了！糟了
糟了糟了糟了糟了糟了！
这些办公机器不该这样运作的！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[马兹翁]
诺阿玛...！
这些机器又出故障了！
马上过来！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[诺阿玛]
什么？！
别烦我了，
我什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Yoo hoo hoo~
Oh, how I love
love love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
哟呵呵~
哦，我多么
多么多么喜欢巧克力！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Eat it up...
Or just melt it.
Slather it all over me.
Booyah. New life aspiration.
scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
吃掉它...
或者干脆融化它。
把它全涂在我身上。
太棒了。新的人生目标。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Jorje seems so cranky
recently. He's usually
more laid back than this.
Oh well, I hope that he
feels better.
scripts.translation:
[英也]
约尔赫最近似乎很烦躁。
他平时没这么急躁的。
算了，希望他能好起来。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Ooh, would you like
to look at my miniature
doll collection? I love
collecting cute dolls!
scripts.translation:
[英也]
哦，你想看看我的
迷你娃娃收藏吗？
我喜欢收集可爱的娃娃！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found a blackboard
filled with scribbling. You
can only read some of the
messages that have been
quickly scrawled on it.^000000
scripts.translation:

你只能看清其中一些匆忙写下的留言。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rocky]
Woof woof!
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Rocky]
Grrrrrrr...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
呜呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Jay]
My mommy and daddy
always come home late.
So I eat dinner alone.
All by myself. Everyday.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊]
爸爸妈妈总是很晚才回家。
所以我总是独自吃晚饭。
一个人。每一天都是这样。

scripts.text:
[Jay]
Food doesn't taste as
good when you're not
eating with anybody.
Maybe I'm just lonely.
scripts.translation:
[杰伊]
一个人吃饭，食物好像没那么好吃了。
也许...我只是有点孤单。

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
This house is enormous...
It's clearly much too big
for a regularly sized family.
And it takes me forever to
make sure that it stays clean!
scripts.translation:
[女仆 简]
这房子好大...
对于普通家庭来说，
这明显太大了。
而且我要花很长时间
才能把它打扫干净！

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
It's not easy keeping
things neat and tidy when
you're responsible for acres
of indoor living space. Being
a maid can be pretty hard...
scripts.translation:
[女仆 简]
负责这么大
室内空间，
要保持整洁并不容易。
做女仆真的很辛苦...

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Brenda]
I better dust extra
gently around this vase.
It's worth ten million zeny
and if it were to-- No. No!
I'm not even going to think it!
scripts.translation:
[女仆 布伦达]
在这个花瓶附近
我要格外小心地擦灰。
它价值一千万Zeny，
如果它碎了——不！不！
我甚至不想去想那种情况！

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Down there, the repairman
is just finishing maintenance
on our chairman's private
Airship. Can you imagine
having one of those of your
very own to fly around in?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
下面，修理工
正在完成我们会长
私人飞空艇的维护。
你能想象拥有
这样一艘飞空艇
在空中自由翱翔吗？

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Yeah, the chairman of
the Rekenber Corporation...
He's a really powerful person.
It's almost scary what he can
do with his money, you know?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
是的，雷肯贝尔公司的会长...
他是一个非常有权势的人。
你知道的，
他有钱到几乎让人害怕。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Dude, check it out~
Official glossy photos
of the Kafra Ladies. Now...
With 20% more garter belts!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
哥们，快看~
卡普拉女士们的
官方写真集。现在...
吊袜带增加了20%！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
So they're all wearing
garter belts in these?
Whoa, that means they
even got the glasses chick
to wear 'em too? That's the
best news I've heard all day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
所以她们都穿着吊袜带？
哇，这意味着连
戴眼镜的那位
也穿上了？
这是我今天听到的
最好的消息！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Okay man, you know these
are limited edition collector's
items, so each one is worth
300,000 zeny. I mean, I have
an extra set, but I don't know
if you'd wanna buy them off--
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
听着，你知道这些
是限量版收藏品，
每套价值300,000 Zeny。
我是有一套多余的，
但我不确定你是否
想从我这里买——

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
I'll take them all.
Wait, all of them except
for that young kid. Just the
idea of having her glamour
photo around strikes me as...
Yeah. Yeah, it's no good.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
我全都要了。
等等，除了那个
小女孩的那套。
光是想到把她的
写真集放在身边...
是的。是的，不行。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Whoa, whoa. Now this...
This is art. The lighting,
the angle, the... the...
subject matter. Oh yes.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
哇，哇。这个...
这才是艺术。光线，
角度，还有...
拍摄对象。哦，是的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Man, these officially licensed
Kafra Lady glossies... They're
worth every zeny we paid. Say
goodbye Swimsuit Calendar,
and hellooooo Kafra Leilah~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
天哪，这些官方授权的
卡普拉女士写真集...
我们花的每一分Zeny
都值了。再见了泳装日历，
你好啊，卡普拉 莱拉~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Leilah? Oh, you mean
the glasses chick? Dude...
Dude. She's my favorite too!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
莱拉？哦，你是说
那个戴眼镜的女孩？
兄弟...
兄弟。她也是我的最爱！

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Sometimes the simple
pleasures can give you
the most happiness. For me,
going outside and basking in
the sun is the greatest thing~
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
有时候，简单的乐趣
能给你带来最大的幸福。
对我来说，
走到户外享受阳光
是最棒的事情~

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Yes, sunbathing in a quiet
and relaxing place can be
so refreshing. And if you're
careful about not getting a
sunburn or a tan, a little sun
can be really good for you.
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
是的，在安静放松的地方
晒晒太阳真的很惬意。
只要注意不要晒伤
或晒黑，适度的阳光
对身体其实很有好处。

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
Curses...
I've come to the
wrong place to seek
out a challenge. No
one here is really all
that mighty or competitive!
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
该死...
我找错了地方
来寻求挑战。
这里的人
都不怎么强大，
也缺乏好胜心！

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
This whole city thinks
it can buy power and safety
with money. They don't know
the value of a nice, friendly
brawl. Hopefully, I'll find a
rival around here soon...
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
这座城市的居民
似乎认为可以用金钱
买到力量和安全。
他们不知道
一场友好切磋的价值。
希望我很快能在这里
找到对手...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
This city might have
more guards and rules
than other places, but
I still don't know if it's
really safe to live here.
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
这座城市可能比其他地方
有更多的卫兵和规定，
但我仍然不确定
住在这里是否真的安全。

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
I mean, the reason we have
these rules is because of all
the unruly gangsters that can
sometimes get into the city.
I mean, it's relatively peaceful and all. But these rules...
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
我的意思是，
之所以有这些规定，
是因为有时会有
不守规矩的流氓
混入城中。
虽然这里相对和平，
但是这些规定...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
It's good to be safe,
but I don't know if it's
a good idea to sacrifice
our freedoms or standard
of living, you know?
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
安全固然好，
但我不确定为了安全
而牺牲我们的自由
或生活水平
是否是个好主意，
你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Oh, you youngsters.
Always traveling around
and having adventures and
fighting monsters. I certainly
had my fill of excitement back
when I was your age, long ago.
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
哦，你们这些年轻人。
总是四处旅行，
经历冒险，
与魔物战斗。
我年轻的时候
也经历过很多刺激的事，
那是很久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Sure, I miss doing all
of that, but now I'm content
with just relaxing and resting.
Still, there are a lot of old folk who refuse to sit still like this~
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
当然，我怀念那些日子，
但现在我只满足于
放松和休息。
不过，还是有很多老人
不愿意像这样安坐不动~

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
Granny may be happy
just sitting around and
enjoying the peaceful life,
but I'm not! I'm too young
to just lay down and let
these days just pass by!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
老奶奶可能很享受
坐着享受平静生活，
但我不行！我还太年轻，
不能就这样躺下，
任由日子流逝！

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
I wanna make something
of myself. Maybe someday,
I'll found a company as big
as the Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
我想成就一番事业。
也许有一天，
我会创立一家
像雷肯贝尔公司
那样大的企业！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
Unlike most places,
Lighthalzen has many
beautiful clothing and
accessory shops. This
place is heaven to a
trend-setter like me~!
scripts.translation:
[金米]
与大多数地方不同，
里希塔乐镇有很多
漂亮的服装和
饰品店。这里
对于像我这样的
潮流引领者来说
简直是天堂~！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
I don't know if you
adventurers are interested
in fashion, but you can trash
your old clothes and get some
new, unique and trendy gear
over here in Lighthalzen~
scripts.translation:
[金米]
我不知道你们冒险者
是否对时尚感兴趣，
但你们可以扔掉旧衣服，
在这里里希塔乐镇
买到新颖、独特
且时髦的装备~

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
Another hungry day...
I don't have any money
and even if I did, there's
no place that sells food
I'd actually eat. Oh, man.
I'm barely living as it is.
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
又是饥饿的一天...
我身无分文，
即使有钱，
也没有地方卖
我真正想吃的食物。
天哪。
我现在勉强维持生计。

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
I hear that the people
who live Uptown eat totally
delicious, gourmet food eight
times a day! Hopefully it's just an exaggeration. 'Cuz if it
wasn't, I'd be so mad...
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
我听说住在
上城区的人
一天吃八顿
美味的美食！
希望这只是夸大其词。
如果不是，
我会气疯的...

scripts.text:
[Avetis]
A-ack...
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Would you give me
some m-medicine?!
^333333*Cough cough haack*^000000
Sweet Christmas, it hurts...

[Avetis]
I sk-skipped work
because I've been too
sick t-to go. ^333333*Cough*^000000
But now I don't have
the money to ^333333*Haack*^000000
buy med-medicine...
scripts.translation:
[阿维蒂斯]
我...我请了病假，
因为我病得太重
无法去上班。^333333*咳*^000000
但现在我没有钱
^333333*咳*^000000
买...买药...

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh wow, that weapon
is fantastic! But I'm sure
that it must be really
expensive. Huh...
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哇，那把武器
太棒了！但我肯定
它一定非常昂贵。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ma'am, are you talking
about this Stiletto? You
certainly have an eye for
quality weapons. If you
don't mind me asking,
where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[店员]
女士，您说的是
这把匕首吗？
您的眼光真不错，
很懂高品质武器。
如果不介意的话，
请问您来自哪里？

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, I was born
and raised in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，我出生并
在莫洛克长大。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ah yes, I've heard many
good things about that town.
You've certainly proven that
people from Morocc truly have
good taste. Now, this Stiletto
is a steal at 39,800 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[店员]
啊，是的，我听说过
关于那个城镇的许多
好话。您确实证明了
来自莫洛克的人
品味确实很好。现在，
这把匕首以39,800 Zeny
的价格简直是捡漏了...

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Huh...?!
That's ridiculous!
Never mind that, let
me take a look at that
Gladius in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
嗯...？！
这太荒唐了！
算了，让我看看
角落里的那把
短剑。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
The Gladius?
Ah, that would be
39,800 zeny, ma'am.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
短剑？
啊，那把是
39,800 Zeny，女士。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, that's a really
good price. I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，这个价格
真的很不错。我买了！

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Yes, this replica really
does look just like an
actual Gladius, does it
not? Although not a true
weapon, it's quite capable of
opening the toughest envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
是的，这个复制品
看起来确实
就像真正的短剑，
不是吗？虽然它不是
真正的武器，但它
完全有能力
打开最顽固的信封。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
...
......
I take that back.
This shop really sucks.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
...
......
我收回刚才的话。
这家店真的很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Welcome to our
store where we offer
many unique products that
you can't find anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
欢迎来到我们
的商店，这里提供
许多您在别处
找不到的独特产品。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
However, shopping is only available to our members. There's an annual
membership fee that's waived when you spend a certain amount every
month in our store. If you invite your friends, you'll receive spe--
scripts.translation:
[店员]
不过，购物仅向我们的
会员开放。每年都有
会员费，但如果您
每月在我们商店消费
达到一定金额，
该费用将被免除。如果您
邀请您的朋友，您将获得特...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no thank you!
I'm not interested!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...不用了！
我不感兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
You know, there's an
interesting story about
the axe that's hanging
over there. Would you
like me to tell you?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
你知道吗，关于
挂在那里的斧头
有一个有趣的故事。
你想听我讲讲吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
This previous owner of
this Weapon Shop was
a convicted serial killer.
Each night, he'd take that
axe and cruelly murder
beautiful ladies like me.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
这家武器店的
前店主是一个
被判刑的连环杀手。
每天晚上，他都会
拿起那把斧头，
残忍地杀害像我这样
美丽的女士。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
When he was finally
caught, they beheaded
him with his own axe.
Since then, they say that
his ghost still lingers and
sharpens this axe at night.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
当他最终被抓获时，
他们用自己的斧头
砍下了他的头。
从那以后，据说
他的幽灵仍然徘徊，
并在夜间磨这把斧头。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Just thinking about
it gives me goosebumps!
And I'm supposed to work
here! It's so creepy!
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
光是想想
就让我起鸡皮疙瘩！
而我居然要在这里
工作！太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Oh, how disappointing~
It's the perfect story for
the season. Well, now that
I think about it, that story is
actually pretty creepy...
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
哦，真令人失望~
这是适合这个季节的
完美故事。嗯，现在
仔细想想，那个故事
其实相当可怕...

scripts.text:
[Srinivas]
Those rundown buildings
in the slums are an eyesore
that offend the entire city!
I just wish they would wreck
them down. What do I care
about the poor and needy?
scripts.translation:
[斯里尼瓦斯]
贫民窟里那些
破旧的建筑是
整个城市的耻辱！
我真希望他们能
把它们拆掉。我
才不在乎那些
贫穷和需要帮助的人呢。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Corporation
actually created the
environment in Lighthalzen
through artificial means.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
我听说
雷肯贝尔公司
实际上是通过
人工手段
创造了里希塔乐镇的
环境。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
It seems like it'd take
a lot of investment, but
artificially creating an
environment isn't impossible
with the means available to
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
这似乎需要
大量的投资，但
人工创造环境
对于雷肯贝尔公司
来说并非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Still, it's pretty
depressing to think
that the beauty of nature
can be man-made and
equated to zeny, you know?
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
不过，想到自然之美
可以是人工制造的，
并且等同于Zeny，
这确实让人很沮丧，
你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
The weather is so
nice today, like always.
I just want to ditch work,
run outside and work out.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
今天的天气
真好，一如既往。
我只想辞掉工作，
跑到外面去锻炼。

scripts.text: Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation: 你想去哪里？

scripts.text: But shouldn't you go to work?
scripts.translation: 但你不是该去上班吗？

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过连环杀手吗？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Well, those guys in
black suits, not to mention
the ruffians that manage to
invade town, sometimes sort
of make it kind of unsafe to
go out all by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
嗯，那些穿黑西装的家伙，还有那些闯进镇上的流氓，有时候让你一个人出门确实不太安全。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
But me and a buddy are
planning to head to the
Al De Baran Turbo Track
one of these days. Boy,
the last time we went,
he wasted a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
不过我和巴迪打算找个时间去艾尔帕兰涡轮赛道。天哪，上次我们去的时候，他花了好多Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
He actually won some
kind of potion as a prize
and let me have it. I drank
it and it made me move really
slowly. Now what kind of prize
is that supposed to be?!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
他居然赢了某种药水作为奖品，还让我喝了。结果我喝完后动作变得超级慢。这算什么奖品啊？！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I think my buddy
was totally scammed.
That, or I was totally
tricked by him to drink it.
How they came up with such a ridiculous idea for a prize!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
我觉得巴迪肯定是被骗了。或者，是我被他骗着喝下的。他们怎么会想出这么荒谬的奖品主意！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Wha--?! I didn't say
I was going to ditch work,
I just said I wanted to!
But just to spite you, maybe
just maybe, I won't go today!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什...？！我没说我要旷工，我只是说我想！但为了气你，也许...也许我今天就不去了！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Then again, I don't
think I can slack on
this project. Curses...
The weekend certainly
doesn't come fast enough!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
不过话说回来，我觉得我不能在这个项目上偷懒。该死...
周末怎么过得这么慢！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
What, you mean that
axe murderer from a long
time ago? Well, I heard a
rumor that it actually wasn't
like that. Let's see, how
did the story go?
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什么，你是说很久以前那个斧头杀手？嗯，我听说其实情况不是那样的。让我想想，故事是怎么说的？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I heard that some hat
maker, the one who makes
the Smokie Hat, accidentally
made a Person Headgear
instead of, like, a hat made
of monsters. Don't ask me how.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
我听说有个帽子匠，就是做狸猫帽子的那个，不小心把“人头”头饰做成了怪物做的帽子。别问我为什么。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Yeah, I think relatives
of that Airship Captain...
They were totally made into
a hat on accident. Supposedly,
it looks like a Reindeer Head,
but now that's just too weird.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
是的，我觉得那是飞空艇船长的亲戚...
他们被意外做成了帽子。据说看起来像驯鹿头，但这实在太奇怪了。

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Arrrgh, I don't
have any time for
talking! I'm in the
middle of an important
task! H-hold on a second!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
啊...我没时间聊天！我正在执行重要任务！等...等一下！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
D-don't come any
closer! Anyone who
comes near me might
just screw me up! Back off!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
别...别靠近我！靠近我的人可能会让我出丑！退后！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Oh man...
I've been working so
hard and haven't taken
any breaks. I think I'll
reward myself and buy
something like maybe--
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
天哪...
我工作这么辛苦，还没休息过。我想奖励一下自己，买点什么，比如...

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
No! No, I'm not
gonna buy anything!
I've got my future wife
to think about! Must...
Save... More... Money!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
不！不，我不买任何东西！我得为未来的妻子着想！必须...存...更多...钱！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh...!
Good heavens!
Um, may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
哦...！
天哪！
嗯，有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh, you're an Assassin!
Oh, you boys are soooo cute!
And so cool and so mysterious all at the same time! I love you!
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
哦，你是刺客！
哦，你们男生好可爱！
又酷又神秘，太迷人了！我爱死你们了！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
An Assassin...?
Oh, you wouldn't happen
to know any Assassin boys
that might be single, do you?
Oh-my-god, they're hunky-hot~
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
刺客...？
哦，你该不会认识哪个单身的刺客男生吧？
天哪，他们好帅~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...?
That sound. Did...
Did someone just
take my picture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么？
那个声音。难道...
刚才有人给我拍照了？

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Welcome to the
temporary headquarters
of Cool Event Corporation.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
欢迎来到酷事件公司
的临时总部。
请问有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Temporary headquarters?
scripts.translation: 临时总部？

scripts.text: Voting
scripts.translation: 投票

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Our headquarters building
is currently undergoing
reconstruction, so we are
basing our operations in
this place for the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
我们的总部大楼目前正在
进行改建，所以暂时
将业务设在这个地方。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司
和酷事件公司正在合作
开发一项新服务，
可以直接瞬间移动
到地下城。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting our valued customers to choose the company they want.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术原因，
两家公司无法同时
提供前往同一地下城的
瞬间移动服务。因此，
我们将邀请尊贵的客户
选择他们想要的公司。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Only a limited number of
voters will be chosen, so
you can check your voting
eligibility at the headquarters
of both participating companies. Thank you for your patronage~
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
只有有限数量的
投票者会被选中，
您可以在两家参与公司
的总部查询您的
投票资格。感谢您的惠顾~

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司
和酷事件公司正在合作
开发一项新服务，
可以直接瞬间移动
到地下城。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting a number of valued customers to vote for their choice.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术原因，
两家公司无法同时
提供前往同一地下城的
瞬间移动服务。因此，
我们将邀请部分尊贵的客户
投票选择他们想要的公司。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
I've just reviewed your
information and would like
to inform you that you are
indeed eligible to vote.
Your participation in this
election is much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
我刚查看了您的
信息，很高兴地通知您，
您确实有资格投票。
非常感谢您的参与。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Remember that the
election polls can be
found in either Prontera
or Juno. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
请记得，
投票箱可以在
普隆德拉或朱诺找到。
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Thank you.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
谢谢。
祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I don't like this.
But I don't like that
idea either. What will
I do for a new event, eh?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
我不喜欢这个。
但我也讨厌那个
主意。新活动
我该做什么好呢？

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I need something
major, something that'll
really shake up the world,
something epochal, but what?
Hey, do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
我需要一些
重大的、能真正
震撼世界的、
具有划时代意义的东西，
但是什么呢？
嘿，你有什么主意吗？

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
Hmmm...
The employees seem
to be having too much
fun amongst themselves
recently. This does not
bode well at all...
scripts.translation:
[包托]
嗯...
最近员工们似乎
玩得太开心了。
这可不是好兆头...

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
It looks like I'm
just going to have to
start cracking that whip
more often and much
harder. Ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[包托]
看来我不得不
更频繁地、更用力地
挥舞鞭子了。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
Ack! I'm totally
swamped with all this
work! But I don't wanna
do any of it. That's it!
I totally need a break.
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
哎呀！我被这堆工作
完全淹没了！但我不想
做任何事。就这样！
我完全需要休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wonder if Saera
would ever consider
going out with me?
That would be nice~
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
不知道赛拉
会不会考虑
和我约会呢？
那该多好啊~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
Greetings. As part of our
effort to relieve the poor,
Rekenber is providing job
opportunities targeted for
citizens of the slum areas.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您好。作为我们
帮助贫困人群的努力的一部分，
雷肯贝尔正在提供
针对贫民区市民的
工作机会。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
You can choose to work
from home, or undergo a
little bit of training for more
professional positions. This
is a great chance to make a
difference... and some money~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您可以选择
在家工作，或者接受
一点培训以获得
更专业的工作。这是一个
改变生活...以及赚点钱的
好机会~

scripts.text:
[A Scientist]
What happened? All the machines are ruined and the research report are gone! The history of Regenschirm has been hacked!
scripts.translation:
[一位科学家]
发生什么事了？所有的机器都毁了，研究报告也不见了！雷根修芦的历史记录被篡改了！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
It takes so long for
this device to process
all the data and give me
the results. Still, the wait
heightens my anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
这台设备处理所有数据并给出结果需要很长时间。不过，等待反而让我更加期待...

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
What?! Guards!
Hurry, there's an
intruder right here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
什么？！卫兵！
快过来，这里有个入侵者！
